# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series, dying four years later  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking man with an ungainly, stooping figure. He wears long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders and has maintained a full, soft brown beard since his twenties.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is an extraordinarily shy, quiet, and gentle man who dreads strangers, particularly women and young girls. Despite his silent nature, he harbors deep warmth and indulgence toward those he cares for, often quietly persisting in his desires without argument. He enjoys listening to talkative people as long as he is not expected to speak himself, and he forms a swift, deep bond of affection with Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

- To support and provide for Anne, ensuring her happiness and education  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lives at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Due to advancing age and heart trouble, the siblings decide to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm work, but a misunderstanding results in the arrival of an eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley. Matthew is instantly won over by Anne's cheerful chatter on the drive from the station and quietly insists on keeping her. Over the next four years, he remains Anne's devoted confidant and champion, frequently spoiling her with treats and a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas. When Anne passes her entrance examinations to Queen's Academy and subsequently wins the Avery Scholarship, Matthew takes immense pride in her achievements. Following her graduation, Matthew suffers a sudden, fatal heart attack upon reading news of the failure of the Abbey Bank, where his life savings were deposited, and he is buried in the Avonlea graveyard.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_
